html:
The Bosnian War was fought from 1992 to 1995 after Bosnia and Herzegovina declared independence from Yugoslavia following a referendum boycotted by most Serbs.

Bosnian Serb forces, armed by the Yugoslav army and backed by Milošević, took about 70 percent of the country and drove out Bosniaks and Croats in campaigns of ethnic cleansing, with camps and mass rape. Bosnian Croat forces, backed by Croatia, also fought the Bosniaks in 1993 and destroyed the Stari Most. About 100,000 people died and two million fled. After the Srebrenica massacre and NATO air strikes, the Dayton Agreement ended the war. It was the deadliest conflict of the Yugoslav wars.
sum: The Bosnian War was fought from 1992 to 1995 after Bosnia and Herzegovina declared independence from Yugoslavia following a referendum boycotted by most Serbs.
